description: Verifies the reference frame transformations: the ICRF to ecliptic round trip reproduces the original state, the identity Lorentz boost is the identity matrix, and the boost along x has the Lorentz factor on the diagonal and its negative product with the velocity off the diagonal.

checks.label: the round trip restores position component 1
the round trip restores velocity component 1
the round trip restores position component 2
the round trip restores velocity component 2
the round trip restores position component 3
the round trip restores velocity component 3
the zero boost has a unit time-time component
the zero boost has a unit x-x component
the time-time component equals the Lorentz factor
the time-x component equals minus gamma times beta
